description: Describe one element of a parsed model by qualified name or, with lookup, by a reported id (the GetSymbol RPC): its kind, metadata, children, members (own, then inherited with the type each comes from; standard-library ones withheld unless asked for), attributes with their declared values, static type facts, multiplicity and specializations. An unknown name answers with `error` set rather than failing. The result is the SymbolResponse as protojson writes it.

includeLibraryMembers.description: list the members inherited from standard-library content too, which are otherwise withheld and counted

lookup.description: what symbolId is, stated rather than guessed: LOOKUP_KIND_QUALIFIED_NAME reads it only as a qualified name, LOOKUP_KIND_ELEMENT_ID only as an id an answer reported (a childIds or members entry, a positional id as Owner::@3, an unnamed connector end's id); empty reads a name first, then an id; resolveName is ignored once it is stated

memberOf.description: the type the element is read as a feature of, as Demo::Vehicle::fuelPort: the direction reported is then the one relative to that type, which a conjugated port typing reverses

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

resolveName.description: resolve symbolId as a qualified name from the root namespace as the notation does: through imports, an alias answered by the element it names, a member not visible from outside its namespace not found; otherwise symbolId is an id the service reported

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

symbolId.description: the element's qualified name, as Demo::Vehicle::mass

name: symbol
